The '''Gundark Base''' was a bunker located a short distance north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was controlled by the [[Gundark gang]].

==History==
[[File:GundarkBaseInterior.jpg|200px|thumb|Gundark gang members inside their base]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] criminal [[Ponda Baba]] hired some Gundark thug and committed a number of break-ins at [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] labs on Rori.<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orden Tarc]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with interrogating Gundark members at the base until one of them gave up information pertaining to Ponda Baba.<ref name="SWG:RHM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gundark Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:RHM" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Gundark Base was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
